name: Dumbbell Arnold Press
steps: Sit upright on a bench with feet flat and hold a dumbbell in front of each shoulder, palms facing you.
Brace your core with elbows tucked in front of your ribs and wrists neutral.
Rotate your palms forward and open your elbows as you press both dumbbells smoothly overhead.
Lower the dumbbells under control, rotating your palms back toward your face at shoulder level.
tips: Let your elbows follow the rotation naturally without forcing them behind your torso.
Keep your lower ribs down instead of arching your lower back as you press overhead.
